text:
alex: Heads-up — canary run of raven-int8 against the demo toolcall eval is showing ~6% funcall parse failures vs the fp16 baseline. Dumping outputs and quick notes here, want quick triage before we roll.

samir: Can you paste a couple of raw model outputs and the exact parser error? that delta is worrying.

alex: Sure. Example model output (raw):
```json
{"tool":"search","arguments":"{\"query\":\"redwood inference\"}"}
```
Parser error when trying to json.loads(arguments):
```
JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```
Also saw outputs like:
```json
{"tool":"open_file","arguments":{"path":"/src/main.py"},}
```
(trailing comma)

marta: Those two failure modes (stringified JSON in arguments, trailing commas) smell like tokenization shifts + model producing literal quotes/backticks around a JSON blob. we've seen that crop up after quantizing sequence length tokens get remapped.

eva: Agreed. Quick experiments to try:
- lower temperature to 0.0 and re-run subset (reduces hallucinated punctuation)
- enable runtime json_rescue heuristics (we have a flag that tries to parse stringified args and strip trailing commas)
- capture token-level alignment heatmap between fp16 vs int8 for the same prompts

samir: I can run temp=0.0 and temp=0.2 A/B on 2k samples. Also will try strictness/backoff changes: retry with "repair" mode which runs these steps:
1) if parse fails try json.loads on the field (if it's a string)
2) run regex to remove trailing commas and unbalanced backticks
3) try a single low-temp re-request with 3-token prefix of previous output

alex: here's a quick curl to toggle the rescue flag in the canary runtime (for on-prem testing):
```bash
curl -X POST $CANARY_ADMIN/api/1/runtime/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"raven-int8","flags":["json_rescue"]}'
```

deploy-bot: canary/raven-int8 deploy finished at 2026-03-20T12:02:30Z :rocket:

marta: I'll capture the kv-cache token divergence heatmap. hypothesis: quantization changes softmax rounding leading to an off-by-one token early EOS emission which then makes model wrap the JSON in backticks.

eva: also log that the schema validator currently treats arguments both as object or string. we should make validator more tolerant for rollout (accept string and attempt parse) and also emit a per-request "repair_applied" metric so we can measure how often rescue is used.

samir: Plan for next 48h:
- samir: run A/B on 10k samples (temp 0.0 / 0.2), collect parse-fail counts and repaired_count (started now)
- marta: generate token alignment heatmap and send to this thread
- alex: open a GH issue in infra/runtimes with failing examples + canary id

alex: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/issues/512 (put examples and deploy id) — assign samir + marta. Will also gate canary rollout until repaired_rate < 1% or we have automated repair metrics.

eva: small note — for Dedicated customers we should enable repair-by-default as a compatibility mode during rollout windows, but gate for hosted customers unless they opt-in (billing/SLAs).

samir: starting the eval run now, will post intermediate heatmap in ~2h. if repair heuristics fix >80% of fails with low false positives, we can keep int8 but ship rescue in next minor.

alex: thanks. :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a brief postmortem template once we have numbers.
